description: This source file defines an interface 'ThingModifiedEvent' which models an event triggered after a 'Thing' has been modified within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThingModifiedEvent
classes.description: An interface representing an event that occurs after a 'Thing' has been modified. It extends 'ThingEvent' and includes a method to set Ditto headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the event and returns an instance of the event type.
